title: The producer enqueues two jobs
label: PUT
caption: j1 and j2 wait in the queue; both workers are idle.

title: Each worker takes one
label: TAKE
caption: Workers take from the head of the queue, oldest first, one job each.

title: More jobs arrive
label: PUT
caption: The producer keeps putting while the workers run. Two of four slots are used.

title: A worker finishes and takes the next
label: DONE
caption: Worker 1 completes j1 and takes j3. Under steady load the queue stays short and never reaches its bound.

title: Both workers are busy
label: BUSY
caption: j1 and j2 are running and j3 waits. The producer is about to send a burst.

title: The burst fills the queue
label: FILL
caption: j4 to j6 arrive faster than the workers finish. The queue holds four jobs: its bound.

title: put() blocks the producer
label: BACKPRESSURE
caption: The queue is full, so put(j7) waits instead of growing the queue. The producer slows to the workers' pace.

title: A worker frees a slot
label: TAKE
caption: Worker 1 completes j1 and takes j3. That frees a slot and wakes the blocked put.

title: The waiting put goes through
label: RESUME
caption: j7 takes the free slot and the queue is full again, so put(j8) blocks until the next completion.
